camargo-treadmill/gait.description: Each subject's mean stride length and frequency at each treadmill speed (0.5-2.05 m/s)

camargo-treadmill/feedback.description: Foot-placement fits per subject (OOD human reference; overground walking, coordinate-based strikes)

camargo-treadmill/sagittal.description: Each subject's mean sagittal hip, knee and ankle angles over the gait cycle (101 points from foot strike) at each treadmill speed 0.5-1.85 m/s

camargo-treadmill/kinetics.description: Per-stride GRF, joint-work and centre-of-mass features (humanlike.kinetics.FEATURES) of the treadmill walking at 0.5-2.05 m/s, with each subject's mass and leg length
